rules.title: Rules
rules.goal.title: Goal
rules.goal.text: Both players have 20 life. Bring your opponent to zero.
rules.turn.title: Turn
rules.turn.text: Draw a card at the start of your turn (the starting player skips the first draw). Then play cards. Finally attack or end the turn – attacking ends the turn, so play your cards first.
rules.energy.title: Energy and sources
rules.energy.text: You may play one source per turn. Each source gives +1 energy for good, and energy refills at the start of every turn. A card costs its price in energy and needs at least one source of its element (Forge, Bedrock or Mist).
rules.lanes.title: Lanes and combat
rules.lanes.text: Each side has three lanes. A creature attacks its own lane. The opposing creature defends automatically, and both deal their power as damage to each other. If the lane is empty, the damage hits the opponent.
rules.units.title: Creatures
rules.units.text: Creatures stay on the board. ⚔ is power, ♥ is health. When a creature has taken as much damage as its health, it dies. A new creature is tired and can’t attack that turn (unless Swift). Creatures can both attack and defend.
rules.spells.title: Spells
rules.spells.text: A spell takes effect at once and goes to the discard pile. If it has a target, choose it when you play the spell.
rules.deck.title: Running out of cards
rules.deck.text: If your deck is empty, every draw deals growing damage to you: 1, 2, 3 …
rules.run.title: Run
rules.run.text: Open a booster and build a 20–30 card deck from it plus free sources. Each win gives a new booster and a tougher opponent. The first loss ends the run – seven wins complete it.
rules.keywords.title: Keywords
menu.tutorialOffer: New here? Learn the rules in a short tutorial match.
hint.attack: Nothing to play – attack or end your turn
hint.endTurn: Nothing to play – end your turn
tut.welcome: Welcome! Your goal is to bring your opponent’s life to zero. I’ll teach the rules one at a time.
tut.source: Sources give energy. Tap the Forge Source and press Play. You can play one source per turn.
tut.unit: You now have 1 energy. Tap the Spark Warrior (cost 1) and pick a lane for it.
tut.tired: A new creature is tired and can’t attack this turn. Press End turn.
tut.draw: You drew a card at the start of your turn. Play the Bedrock Source – play cards before attacking, because attacking ends your turn.
tut.attack: Attack! A creature attacks its own lane. With nobody opposite, the damage goes straight to the opponent.
tut.defender: The opponent played a Moss Troll in your lane – the opposing creature defends automatically. Play a source first.
tut.spell: Firebrand is a spell: 2 damage to an enemy you choose. Tap Firebrand and target the Moss Troll.
tut.keyword: Ember Hound has the keyword Swift: it can attack right away. Tap a card to read its details, then play it.
tut.attackBoth: The lanes are open. Attack with both creatures!
tut.free: Great! A Sentinel also guards an adjacent empty lane. You know the basics now – win the match on your own.
tut.follow: Follow the guide – the blue frame shows the next move.
tut.done: Tutorial complete! Start your own run from the main menu.
